messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, or a holiday that is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend, giving you a 3‑day (or sometimes 4‑day) break.)

| Date | Holiday | Notes | Provinces/territories that observe it |
|------|---------|-------|---------------------------------------|
| **Jan 1 2023** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | Observed on **Mon Jan 2** | All provinces & territories |
| **Mon Jan 2 2023** | New Year’s Day (observed) | 4‑day weekend (Sat Jan 1–Mon Jan 2) | All |
| **Mon Feb 20 2023** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island) | 3‑day weekend (Fri Feb 17–Mon Feb 20) | Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, NB, MB, PEI |
| **Fri Mar 31 2023** | Good Friday | 3‑day weekend (Fri Mar 31–Sun Apr 2) | All except Quebec (Quebec has its own “Good Friday” holiday) |
| **Mon May 22 2023** | Victoria Day | 3‑day weekend (Fri May 19–Mon May 22) | All except Quebec (Quebec has its own “Victoria Day” holiday) |
| **Sat Jul 1 2023** | Canada Day | Observed on **Mon Jul 3** (4‑day weekend: Sat Jul 1–Mon Jul 3) | All |
| **Mon Jul 3 2023** | Canada Day (observed) | 4‑day weekend | All |
| **Mon Sep 4 2023** | Labour Day | 3‑day weekend (Fri Sep 1–Mon Sep 4) | All |
| **Mon Oct 9 2023** | Thanksgiving | 3‑day weekend (Fri Oct 6–Mon Oct 9) | All |
| **Mon Dec 25 2023** | Christmas Day | 3‑day weekend (Fri Dec 22–Mon Dec 25) | All |
| **Mon Dec 26 2023** | Boxing Day (observed) | 4‑day weekend (Fri Dec 22–Mon Dec 26) | All |

### Quick Summary (by month)

| Month | Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday |
|-------|--------------------|---------|
| Jan | Jan 1–3 | New Year’s Day |
| Feb | Feb 18–20 | Family Day (Ontario, etc.) |
| Mar | Mar 31–Apr 2 | Good Friday |
| May | May 20–22 | Victoria Day |
| Jul | Jul 1–3 | Canada Day |
| Sep | Sep 2–4 | Labour Day |
| Oct | Oct 7–9 | Thanksgiving |
| Dec | Dec 23–25 | Christmas Day |
| Dec | Dec 23–26 | Boxing Day (observed) |

> **Pro‑Tip:** If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, remember that many holidays are *provincial* (e.g., Family Day, Victoria Day, etc.). You’ll want to let users select their province/territory so you can filter the list accordingly.

### Where to Verify

- **Government of Canada – Public Holidays**: <https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits/public-service.html>
- **Provincial/territorial government sites** (e.g., Ontario’s “Public Holidays” page) for the most up‑to‑date dates.

Feel free to copy the table into your app’s database or use it as a reference for generating calendar events. Happy planning!
